name: Trial of the Lake
summary: Tajarri awaits the result of a trial at the Shrine of Remulos in Moonglade. A Shrine Bauble from Lake Elune'ara is at its heart.

sections.title: At the Shrine
sections.body: At the Shrine of Remulos in northwestern Moonglade, Tajarri asks you to complete a trial. Find a Shrine Bauble in Lake Elune'ara and bring it to the shrine. Use it there, then speak with Tajarri to complete the trial.

faq.q: What does Tajarri ask me to do?
faq.answer: Tajarri asks you to find a Shrine Bauble in Lake Elune'ara, use it at the Shrine of Remulos, then speak with Tajarri.

faq.q: Where is the Shrine of Remulos?
faq.answer: The Shrine of Remulos is in northwestern Moonglade.

faq.q: Where do I find the Shrine Bauble?
faq.answer: The Shrine Bauble is in Lake Elune'ara.

faq.q: What do I do with the Shrine Bauble?
faq.answer: Take the Shrine Bauble to the Shrine of Remulos and use it there.

faq.q: Who do I speak with after using the bauble?
faq.answer: Speak with Tajarri at the shrine after using the Shrine Bauble.
